sentences.en: Dad had pulled up some floorboards.
sentences.zh: 爸爸有拉向上一些木地板条。

sentences.en: "Hello!" He said.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "What's this?"
sentences.zh: 是什么这个？

sentences.en: Under the floor was a stone.
sentences.zh: 在……下方这地板是一个石块。

sentences.en: It had some strange writing on it.
sentences.zh: 它有一些奇怪的写在……上它。

sentences.en: Dad was going to throw the stone away,.
sentences.zh: 爸爸是去到扔这石块离开， 但是 Chip 想要到保持它。

sentences.en: But Chip wanted to keep it.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们想要到飞这风筝。

sentences.en: "Look at this," he said to Biff.
sentences.zh: 看在这个。'

sentences.en: "Do you think the writing is Chinese?"
sentences.zh: 做你想这写是中国的？

sentences.en: "I don't know," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Chip took the stone to school.
sentences.zh: Chip 拿这石块到学校。

sentences.en: He showed it to a boy called Hong.
sentences.zh: 他展示它到一个男孩叫吽。

sentences.en: "It is written in Chinese," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 它是写在……里中国的， 说吽。 不， 说伥。

sentences.en: "I can't read it, but my grandfather can."
sentences.zh: 我不能读它， 但是我的外祖父能。

sentences.en: Hong's grandfather always came after school to take Hong home.
sentences.zh: 轰外祖父总是来在……之后学校到拿吽家。

sentences.en: Chip showed him the stone.
sentences.zh: Chip 展示他这石块。

sentences.en: "Yes, it is Chinese," said Hong's grandfather.
sentences.zh: 是， 它是中国的， 说轰外祖父。 全部正确的， 说轰外祖父。

sentences.en: "It says, 'Do You Mind?"
sentences.zh: 它说， '做你头脑？

sentences.en: "What a strange question," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么一个奇怪的问题， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "It may be a riddle," said Hong's grandfather.
sentences.zh: 它梅是一个谜语， 说轰外祖父。

sentences.en: "See!
sentences.zh: 看见！

sentences.en: The stone is broken.
sentences.zh: 这石块是打破。

sentences.en: Maybe the answer is on the other half."
sentences.zh: 也许这回答是在……上这其他一半。

sentences.en: "All right," said Hong's grandfather.
sentences.zh: 全部正确的， 说轰外祖父。

sentences.en: Chip gave Hong the stone to keep.
sentences.zh: Chip 给吽这石块到保持。

sentences.en: He put it in his bag.
sentences.zh: 他放它在……里他的包。

sentences.en: "May Hong come round to play with us?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 梅吽来圆形的到玩和……一起我们？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "All right," said Hong's grandfather.
They went to play in Biff's room.
sentences.zh: 他们去到玩在……里 Biff 房间。

sentences.en: "What is a riddle?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么是这谜语？ 什么是它？ 问 Chip。

sentences.en: "It's a puzzle in words," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 它是一个谜在……里单词， 说吽。 不， 说伥。

sentences.en: "Here is a good riddle,' said Hong.
sentences.zh: 这里是一个好的谜语，' 说吽。

sentences.en: "How do you spell 'hungry horse' using only four letters?"
sentences.zh: 如何做你咒语 '饿的马' 我们只有四信？

sentences.en: "We don't know," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "It's easy," Laughed Hong.
sentences.zh: 它是容易的， 说吽。 它是容易的， 笑吽。

sentences.en: "M T G G.
Here's another riddle.
sentences.zh: 这里另一个谜语。

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 什么是这个？

sentences.en: The more it dries the more it gets wet."
sentences.zh: 这更多它干的这更多它得到湿的。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took them to a rocky valley.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们到一个岩石的山谷。

sentences.en: Four paths met.
sentences.zh: 四小路遇见。

sentences.en: There was a signpost pointing four ways.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个路标勾缝水泥四方式。

sentences.en: Each way pointed to Riddle Mountain.
sentences.zh: 每个方式尖的到谜语山。

sentences.en: A boy was sitting on a rock.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩是坐在……上一个岩石。

sentences.en: "My name is Tai," He said.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Ty， 他说。 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "I want to go to Riddle Mountain, but I don't know which path to take.
sentences.zh: 我想要到去到谜语山， 但是我不知道哪个小路到拿。

sentences.en: I can't think of the answer to this riddle."
sentences.zh: 我不能想的这回答到这个谜语。

sentences.en: The riddle was on a tall post.
sentences.zh: 这谜语是在……上一个高的柱。

sentences.en: It said, "It's only one colour, but it can grow.
sentences.zh: 它说， 它是只有一颜色， 但是它能生长。

sentences.en: Sticks to your feet, wherever you go.
sentences.zh: 枝条到你的脚， 究竟在哪里你去。

sentences.en: There in the sun, not in the rain.
sentences.zh: 那里在……里这太阳， 不在……里这雨。

sentences.en: Never does harm, never feels pain."
sentences.zh: 从不做损害， 从不感觉痛苦。

sentences.en: "The answer is a shadow," Said Hong.
sentences.zh: 这回答是一个阴影， 说吽。 不， 说伥。

sentences.en: "Look at the shadow of the post.
sentences.zh: 看在这阴影的这柱。

sentences.en: It points up that path.
sentences.zh: 它尖向上那个小路。

sentences.en: That must be the way." "Are you sure?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 那个必须是这方式。 是你确信的？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "Yes, it's a riddle," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 是， 它是一个谜语， 说 Ty。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "Let's go!" Said Tai.
sentences.zh: 让我们去！ » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "It is hard to get to Riddle Mountain," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 它是困难的到得到到谜语山， 说 Ty。

sentences.en: "It will be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 它将是危险的。

sentences.en: I may never get there."
sentences.zh: 我梅从不得到那里。

sentences.en: "Then why do you have to go?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 然后为什么做你有到去？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I want to be the Riddle Maker," said Ty.
sentences.zh: 我想要到是这谜语做， 说 Ty。

sentences.en: "I have to get to Riddle Mountain.
sentences.zh: 我有到得到到谜语山。

sentences.en: I have to answer all the riddles on the way.
sentences.zh: 我有到回答全部这谜语在……上这方式。

sentences.en: The last riddle is the hardest.
sentences.zh: 这最后的谜语是这困难的。

sentences.en: No one has ever found the answer." Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 不一有在任何时候找到这回答。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a huge giant stood in the way.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 一个极大的巨人站在……里这方式。

sentences.en: "I hope he's friendly," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我希望他是友好的， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Answer this riddle and you can pass by," roared the giant.
sentences.zh: 回答这个谜语和你能通过由， 咆哮这巨人。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "Write down how much I weigh," he said.
sentences.zh: 我写这单词 '如何许多我有'， 说吽。

sentences.en: "But he must weigh tons," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 但是他必须有 tonnes！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "No, it's a riddle," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 不， 它是一个谜语， 说吽。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I can do it."
sentences.zh: 我能做它。

sentences.en: He wrote down the answer.
sentences.zh: 他写向下这回答。

sentences.en: "Good luck in the land of riddles," Said the giant.
sentences.zh: 如何有好的运气在……里这陆地的谜语， 说这巨人。 哦不！ 说这双胞胎之一。

sentences.en: "What did you write down?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么做你写向下？ 问 Chip。 什么是它？ 问 Chip。

sentences.en: "I wrote the words 'how much I weigh'," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 我写这单词 '如何许多我有'， 说吽。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: It was not far to the top of the hill.
sentences.zh: 它是不远到这顶的这小山。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a dragon stood in the way.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 一个龙站在……里这方式。

sentences.en: "I hope he's friendly," Said Hom.
sentences.zh: 我希望他是友好的， 说 Chip。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "Look!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 看！ 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "There are bubbles coming out of his mouth!"
sentences.zh: 那里是泡泡来出的他的嘴！

sentences.en: The dragon spoke.
sentences.zh: 这龙说。

sentences.en: "Over there is Riddle Mountain," it said.
sentences.zh: 在……上方那里是谜语山， 它说。

sentences.en: "You have a long way to go." "Help!" Said Tide.
sentences.zh: 你有一个长的方式到去。 帮助！ 她有一个主意。

sentences.en: "The journey looks dangerous."
sentences.zh: 这旅行看危险的。

sentences.en: Below was a black lake.
sentences.zh: 在是一个黑色的拉客。

sentences.en: Across the lake, the land was dry and rocky.
sentences.zh: 穿过这拉客， 这陆地是干的和岩石的。

sentences.en: Beyond, there was a deep river and dark forest.
sentences.zh: 在， 那里是一个深的河和黑暗的为了。

sentences.en: Far away was a tall, grey mountain.
sentences.zh: 远离开是一个高的， 灰色的山。

sentences.en: It said.
sentences.zh: 它是一个风筝。

sentences.en: Huge bubbles came out of the dragon's jaws.
sentences.zh: 极大的泡泡来出的这龙颌。

sentences.en: "Answer this riddle," it said.
sentences.zh: 回答这个谜语， 它说。

sentences.en: "How many sides does a bubble have?" "That's easy," Said Hom.
sentences.zh: 如何许多面做一个泡泡有？ 那是容易的， 他说。

sentences.en: "It has two, the inside and the outside," He said.
sentences.zh: 这里面和这外面， 他说。 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "Good," "Good," said the dragon.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: "Now step inside this bubble."
sentences.zh: 现在迈步里面这个泡泡。

sentences.en: Hom stepped into the bubble.
sentences.zh: 吽迈步进入这泡泡。

sentences.en: It began to float away. Yelled Hom.
sentences.zh: 它开始到浮离开。 帮助！ 叫喊吽。

sentences.en: "Step into a bubble," yelled Hong.
sentences.zh: 迈步进入一个泡泡， 叫喊吽。

sentences.en: They all stepped inside the bubbles and floated up and up.
sentences.zh: 他们全部迈步里面这泡泡和浮向上和向上。

sentences.en: "This is scary," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个是可怕的， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "What if the bubbles pop?"
sentences.zh: 什么如果这泡泡砰？

sentences.en: They floated on and on.
sentences.zh: 他们浮在……上和在……上。

sentences.en: At last, they began to float down to the black lake.
sentences.zh: 在最后的， 他们开始到浮向下到这黑色的拉客。

sentences.en: "I hope the bubbles don't pop here," yelled Chip.
sentences.zh: 我希望这泡泡不砰这里， 叫喊 Chip。 看出！ 叫喊 Chip。

sentences.en: Then the bubbles popped and the children fell into the lake.
sentences.zh: 然后这泡泡砰和这孩子们落下进入这拉客。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a huge serpent rose out of the water.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 一个极大的巨蛇 rose 出的这水。

sentences.en: "I don't like this adventure," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢这个冒险， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "What is this?"
sentences.zh: 什么是这个？

sentences.en: "Good," said the serpent.
sentences.zh: 好的， 说这巨蛇。

sentences.en: Said the serpent, "the more it dries, the more it gets wet?" "It's easy," Said Hom.
sentences.zh: 什么是这个？ 说这巨蛇， 这更多它干的， 这更多它得到湿的？ 它是容易的， 说吽。

sentences.en: "It's a towel." "Good," "Good," said the serpent.
sentences.zh: 它是一个毛巾。 好的。

sentences.en: "Now climb on my back."
sentences.zh: 现在爬在……上我的回来。

sentences.en: The serpent swam across the lake.
sentences.zh: 这巨蛇游泳穿过这拉客。

sentences.en: "How do you know the answer to all these riddles, Hong?" Asked Ty.
sentences.zh: 如何做你知道这回答到全部这些谜语， 吽？ 问 Ty。 爸爸问。

sentences.en: "I don't know," Said Hom.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说吽。

sentences.en: "They just come to me."
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚来到我。

sentences.en: Goblins were waiting for the children.
sentences.zh: 小妖怪是等为了这孩子们。

sentences.en: They pulled and pinched them.
sentences.zh: 他们拉和苍白清瘦的他们。

sentences.en: "Ouch!
sentences.zh: 哎哟！

sentences.en: That hurts," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 那个受伤。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Ha!
sentences.zh: 哈！

sentences.en: You won't answer the next riddle," Said one of the goblins.
sentences.zh: 你不会回答这下一个谜语， 说一的这小妖怪。

sentences.en: The goblins put the children in a cage.
sentences.zh: 这小妖怪放这孩子们在……里一个笼子。

sentences.en: One of the goblins stole the magic key.
sentences.zh: 一的这小妖怪 stole 这魔法钥匙。

sentences.zh: 哦不！ 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.zh: 现在我们不能得到回来从这个冒险。

sentences.zh: 这小妖怪国王说到他们。

sentences.en: "Answer this," He said.
sentences.zh: 回答这个， 他说。 啊唷！

sentences.zh: 如何做你想要到帝俄？ 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "We don't want to die."
sentences.zh: 我们不想要到帝俄。

sentences.en: Hom began to laugh.
sentences.zh: 吽开始到笑。

sentences.en: "Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha."
"It's not funny," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它是不有趣的， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "We don't want to die."
sentences.zh: 我们不想要到帝俄。

sentences.en: "It's a riddle," said Hong.
sentences.zh: 它是一个谜语， 说吽。

sentences.en: "Don't worry.
sentences.zh: 不担心。

sentences.en: I know the answer."
sentences.zh: 我知道这回答。
